name: organon
description: Organon — the research toolbox for Claude Code and Codex: promptus stores / keeps / retrieves a project's knowledge as gated markdown; editio turns what the store has validated into defensible, submittable papers.

plugins.name: promptus
plugins.description: Store / keep / retrieve a research project's knowledge as gated markdown — a substrate for the LLM agent; grannie is the human read-port (plain-language, grounded answers).

plugins.name: editio
plugins.description: The academic-writing toolchain: turn a promptus store's validated knowledge into defensible, submittable papers — structure, three renders (draft/publish/blind), figures, tables, bibliography, venue packaging, rebuttals. Ships the humanizer style toolkit. Requires the promptus plugin.
